title: Homegrown Workflow Skills vs. the Popular Claude Plugins
description: A side-by-side look at our homegrown session-lifecycle and feature-workflow skills — the /session-start, /feature-define, /feature-ship, /editorial-* families plus DEVELOPMENT-NOTES and feature workplans — against the widely-used Claude plugins that purport to do the same job. Where did homegrown win? Where would a plugin have served better? Criteria: fit-for-purpose, extensibility, maintenance burden, composability with the rest of the skill stack.
